artifact.self_contained_problem:
For integers n ≥ k ≥ 2 and ℓ ≥ 1, define φ(n, k, ℓ) to be the minimum, over all sets P of n points in the Euclidean plane ℝ² with the property that every k-point subset of P determines at least ℓ distinct pairwise distances, of the total number of distinct distances determined by P. (If no such set P exists, φ(n,k,ℓ) is undefined.)

Determine the asymptotic order of φ(n, 5, 9) as n → ∞. In particular, decide whether φ(n, 5, 9) = Ω(n²), or establish the correct asymptotic growth rate. The trivial lower bound φ(n, 5, 9) = Ω(n) is known.
artifact.status_search_result: The question of the asymptotic order of φ(n,5,9), in particular Erdős's question whether φ(n,5,9) = Ω(n²), appears to remain open: the known bound is the trivial Ω(n), and subsequent work on local properties for distinct distances (Fox–Pach–Suk; Sheffer and others) has not closed the gap for the (k,ℓ)=(5,9) case.

status_evidence.title: Local Properties in Colored Graphs, Distinct Distances, and Difference Sets
status_evidence.snippet: Studies local-properties variants for distinct distances, leaving the (k,9) range with k=5 unresolved beyond trivial bounds.
status_evidence.claim: Subsequent work on local properties for distinct distances does not establish the asymptotic order of φ(n,5,9).

status_evidence.title: Distinct Distances: Open Problems and Current Bounds
status_evidence.snippet: Survey listing φ(n,5,9) as an open problem with only the trivial Ω(n) lower bound known.
status_evidence.claim: Determining the asymptotic order of φ(n,5,9) is listed as open.
